status: provisional; not a canonical schema, validated dataset, or completion claim
scope_note: Bounded first discovery pass for publicly reported protests, demonstrations, and related collective actions. Planned actions are distinct from events that occurred. Empty/irrelevant search sets do not demonstrate absence.

capture.timestamp_note: Managed web tool did not expose request-level timestamps; this is the observed bounded query/open window.

queries.query: Zimbabwe protest demonstration April 2026 Harare rally
queries.outcome: Surfaced a planned April 4 MDC march; later ICNL civic monitor states ZRP prohibited it and High Court challenge failed.
No separate Shona-language report surfaced; English local press and ICNL record found.

queries.query: Zimbabwe protest demonstration May 2026 Harare rally
queries.outcome: No dateable May event surfaced; ICNL reports assemblies on constitutional amendment were blocked/disrupted generally, without specific event details.
No clearly dated Shona-language event surfaced in the result set.

queries.query: Zimbabwe protest demonstration June 2026 Harare rally
queries.outcome: Surfaced a planned June 8 anti-CAB3 demonstration; prosecutors later alleged police seized flyers before the scheduled event.
No direct Shona-language report for a June demonstration surfaced; English local court reporting found the planned action.

event_date.value: Planned for 2026-04-04; reported later prohibited; actual gathering not verified
event_date.uncertainty: The planned demonstration is not treated as an event occurrence; no direct event report surfaced.

provisional_leads.location: Africa Unity Square and parts of central Harare, Zimbabwe (announced route).
provisional_leads.action_summary: MDC notified police of a peaceful protest against Constitutional Amendment Bill No. 3; ICNL reports Zimbabwe Police issued a prohibition notice and the party unsuccessfully challenged it in court.
provisional_leads.provisional_status: planned action; prohibition reported, occurrence not confirmed

sources.excerpt: MDC national organising secretary, Clifton Zumba, indicated ... the demonstration will be held on April 4.
sources.provenance: Opened announcement with route/organizer and proposed date; does not establish that it occurred.

sources.publisher: International Center for Not-for-Profit Law, Zimbabwe Civic Freedom Monitor
sources.publication_date: Living country page; date of specific update not stated in opened passage; accessed 2026-10-11
sources.excerpt: In April 2026, the Zimbabwe Republic Police (ZRP) issued a prohibition notice under MOPA barring a planned demonstration.
sources.provenance: Opened living monitor page; states notice, stated police rationale, and unsuccessful High Court challenge. This is not proof of event occurrence.

event_date.value: Planned for 2026-06-08; actual occurrence unverified; police reportedly seized fliers June 3
event_date.uncertainty: This is an alleged planned action described in a court case; the action is not established as having occurred.

provisional_leads.location: Parliament of Zimbabwe, Mt Hampden (planned venue).
provisional_leads.action_summary: Opposition activists allegedly planned a demonstration against CAB3 and circulated flyers; police reportedly recovered 44,600 fliers before the scheduled date.
provisional_leads.provisional_status: planned-action lead based on later court reporting; no demonstration occurrence confirmed

sources.publication_date: Specific page publication date not stated in opened passage; context includes July 8 arrest and July 31 court return
sources.excerpt: According to prosecutors, the demonstration was scheduled for June 8, 2026, at the Parliament of Zimbabwe in Mt Hampden.
sources.provenance: Opened court-reporting article; says police allegedly received tip May 29 and seized 44,600 fliers June 3, before planned June 8 event. These are prosecution allegations.

excluded_or_deferred_results.item: Zimbabweans protest proposed amendment outside Zimbabwe Embassy in London
excluded_or_deferred_results.reason: Event occurred in London, United Kingdom, not Zimbabwe.
Outside Q2; public consultation/hearing rather than Q2 protest.

failures_and_limits: ICNL describes May 2026 assembly disruptions as a pattern but does not identify a date/location/action suitable for a discrete event record. The June 8 action is only an allegation of a planned protest; occurrence is unknown.
next_pass_priorities: Verify whether announced actions occurred and search further local reporting before any event coding or completion claim.
